items.title: Norman Simmons interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 27, 2007 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Who was the saxophone player at that time? Was it Jimmy

ctx.x: I’m glad you brought that up. Because I got this, every once in a while I got this feeling or — that the relationship between Joe and Sweets was strained.
It was. Because all these high-powered egos on that stage. Who was the saxophone player at that time? Was it Jimmy —
